senses.gloss: प्र-दक्षिण mf(आ)n. moving to the right, ŚāṅkhGṛ.
standing or placed on the right (with √ कृ, or प्र-√ कृ, ‘to turn towards persons or things so as to place them on one's right’, ‘turn the right side towards’ as a token of respect), Mn.; MBh. &c.
auspicious, favourable, MBh.; R.
respectful, reverential, MBh.

प्र-दक्षिण mfn. turning the right side towards, circumambulation from left to right of a person or object (gen. or comp.; with √ कृ or √ 1. दा dat. gen. or loc.) as a kind of worship, R.; Kathās.; Pañcat.; RTL. 68, 2; 145 &c.
प्र-दक्षिण॑म् (अ॑म्), ind. from left to right, so that the r˚ side is turned towards a person or object, AV. &c. &c. (also ibc.; cf. comp. below; with √ कृ and प्र-√ कृ as above)
towards the south, Mn.; Var. (˚णेण ind. = अ॑म् in both meanings, BhP.; Var.)
प्र-दक्षिणेण ind., = अ॑म् in both meanings, BhP.; Var.
प्र-दक्षिण—क्रिया f. going round from left to right (as a mark of respect), Ragh.
प्र-दक्षिण—गामि-ता f. the state of one who walks towards the right (one of the 80 minor marks of Buddhists), Dharmas. 84, 15.
प्र-दक्षिण—पट्टिका f. a yard, courtyard, L.
प्रदक्षिणानुलोम mfn. respectful and obedient (said of a slave), MBh.
प्रदक्षिणार्चिस् mfn. shooting out flames towards the right, Ragh.
प्रदक्षिणावर्त mfn. turned towards the r˚, MBh.; R.; Var.
प्रदक्षिणावर्त—नाभिता f. having a navel which turns to the r˚, Dharmas. 84, 40 (cf. ˚ण-गामिता)
प्रदक्षिणावर्त—शिख mfn. = ˚णार्चिस्, MBh.
प्रदक्षिणावर्˚तैक-रोमता f. having single hairs on the body and all turning to the r˚, Dharmas. 83.
प्रदक्षिणावृत्क mfn. turned towards the right, having (any one or anything) on the right, Yājñ.
प्रदक्षिणय Nom. P. ˚यति, to go round from left to right, Śāntiś.; Rājat.
प्रदक्षिणित् ind. from left to right, so as to turn one's right side towards any one or anything, RV.
प्रदक्षिणी-√ कृ P. Ā. -करोति, -कुरुते, to turn the right side towards (acc.), go round from left to right, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
प्र-दग्ध &c. See प्र-√ दह्.
प्र॑-˚दग्ध (प्र॑-), mfn. burnt, destroyed, ŚBr.; R.; Var.
प्र-द॑घस् (Ved. inf. of √ दघ्), to cause to fall, throw down, ŚBr. (w.r. -द॑घोस्).
प्र-दण्ड-वत् mfn. inflicting severe punishment, Parāś.
प्र-दत्त &c. See प्र- √ 1. दा.
प्र-˚दत्त mfn. = प्रत्त, R.; Kathās.; Pañcat. (-नयनोत्सव mfn. affording a feast to the eyes i.e. beautiful to behold, Kathās.)
प्र-˚दत्त m. N. of a Gandharva, R.
प्र-दम् Caus. -दमयते, to subdue, conquer, Bhaṭṭ.
प्र-˚दाम् m. (nom. दान्), Pāṇ. viii, 2, 64, Sch.
प्र-˚दान्त m. pl. N. of a school, L.
प्र-दान्त See प्र-√ दम्.
प्र-दर See प्र-√ दॄ.
प्र-˚दर॑ m. dispersion, rout (of an army), MBh.
a crevice, cleft (in the earth), VS.; Br. &c.
menorrhagia (a disease of women), Car.
a kind of arrow, MBh.
rending, tearing, W.
pl. N. of a people, MBh.
प्र-दर्प m. (√ दृप्) pride, arrogance, MW.
प्र-˚दृपित See अ॑-प्रदृपित.
प्र-˚दृप्त mfn. proud, haughty, conceited, MW.
प्र॑-˚दृप्ति (प्र॑-), f. haughtiness, arrogance, madness, RV.
प्र-दर्विदा (?), Kāś. on Pāṇ. vi, 3, 63 (cf. प्र-फर्विदा).
प्र-दर्श &c. See प्र-√ दृश्.
प्र-दर्श m. look, appearance (see सु-प्रद्˚)
direction, injunction, Suśr.
प्र-दल m. an arrow (= प्र-दर), L.
प्र-दव ˚व्य &c. See प्र- √ 2. दु.
प्र-˚दव mfn. burning, inflaming, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 142, Kāś.
प्र-˚दाव॑ m. id., MaitrS.
प्र-√ दस् P. -दस्यति, to dry up, become dry, Kāṭh.

प्र-√ दह् P. -दहति (ep. also Ā. ˚ते), to burn, consume, destroy, AV. &c. &c.:
Pass. -दह्यते (ep. also ˚ति), to take fire, be burnt, burn, MBh.; Kāv. &c.:
Caus. -दाहयति, to cause to be burnt, Vcar.
प्र॑-˚दग्˚धाहुति (प्र॑-), mfn. one who has burnt the sacrificial oblation, ŚBr.
प्र-˚दग्धव्य mfn. to be burnt, MBh.
प्र-˚दाह m. burning, heating, consuming by fire, Br.; Gaut.
destruction, annihilation, Śaṃk.
प्र-दा f. a gift, L.
प्र-द mf(आ)n. giving, yielding, offering, granting, bestowing, causing, effecting, uttering, speaking (cf. अन्न-, जय-, बहु-, सुख-, -शाप &c.)
प्रा-√ दा (प्र-आ- √ 1. दा) P. -ददाति (inf. प्रा-दातुम् ind.p. प्रा-दाय), to give, bestow, MBh.
प्र-˚दत्त—नयनोत्सव mfn., affording a feast to the eyes i.e. beautiful to behold, Kathās.
प्र-˚ददि See अ॑-प्रददि.

प्र-दातव्य mfn. to be given (also in marriage) or offered or presented or restored or imparted &c. (तेषां संस्कृतम् प्रदातव्यम्, to these Sanskṛt is to be imparted i.e. these are to be taught Sanskṛt, Sāh.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
to be placed or put into, Var.
प्र-˚दातृ॑ m. a giver, bestower (mostly in comp. with the object, rarely with the receiver), AV. &c. &c.
an offerer, presenter (विष-, of poison), Car.
one who gives a daughter in marriage, Mn.; MBh.
an imparter (of knowledge), Pañcat.
a granter (of a wish), BrahmaP. (f. त्री)
N. of Indra, TS.; ŚBr.
of one of the Viśve Devāḥ, MBh.
प्र-˚दा॑त्रिका f. a female giver, MaitrS.
1. प्र-दा॑न n. (for 2. See below) giving, bestowal, presentation (esp. of an offering in the fire; also N. of the sacred text recited on this occasion), TS. &c. &c.
a gift, donation, Mn.; MBh. &c.
giving away in marriage, Mn.; Yājñ. &c.
applying (of a clyster), Suśr.
turning (the eyes), Kum.
making (an attack), Pañcat.
uttering (a curse), VP.
granting (a boon), MBh.
teaching, imparting, announcing, declaring, Mn.; R.; Kathās.
2. प्र-दान n. (√ दो) a goad, L. (for 1. See under प्र- √ 1. दा).
1. प्र-दान—कृपण mfn. mean or niggardly in making presents, MBh.
1. प्र-दान—पूर्वम् ind. with a present, Kathās.
1. प्र-दान—रुचि m. ‘delighting in giving’, N. of a man, Buddh.
1. प्र-दान—वत् mfn. giving, liberal, MBh.
1. प्र-दान—शूर m. ‘a hero in giving’, an excessively liberal man, Lalit.
N. of a Bodhisattva, SaddhP.
प्र-˚दानक n. an offering, donation, Cat.
प्र-˚दानिक See गो-प्र्˚, जल-प्र्˚ and दत्ताप्रदानिक.
प्रा—दानिक mfn. (fr. -दान) relating to an oblation, KātyŚr., Sch.
प्र-˚दापयितृ॑ m. a giver, TS.
प्र-˚दाप्य mfn. to be caused to give or compelled to pay, Yājñ.
प्र-˚दाय n. a present, MBh.
प्र-˚दायक mfn. giving, granting, presenting, bestowing (gen. or comp.), MBh.; R. &c.
प्र-˚दायक—त्व n., Kull.
प्र-˚दायिन् mfn. id., Mn.; MBh. &c.
प्र-˚दा˚यि-त्व n., Kum.
प्र-˚दि m. a gift, present, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 92, Sch.
प्र-√ 2. दी (only pr. Subj. -दी॑दयत् and pf. -दीदियुः), to shine forth, RV.
प्र-˚दित्सा f. (fr. Desid.) desire to give, Jātakam.
प्र-˚दित्सु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to give (with acc.), MBh.
प्र-देय mf(आ)n. to be given or presented or granted or offered or communicated or imparted or taught (with dat., sometimes in comp. with the recipient), Mn.; MBh. &c.
to be instructed or initiated in (loc.), MBh.
प्र-देय m. a present, gift, MBh.; R.
प्र-देया f. to be given in marriage, marriageable, MBh.; R.; Kathās.
प्र-दास m. (?), Divyāv.
प्र-दिग्ध See प्र-√ दिह्.
प्र-˚दिग्ध mfn. smeared over, anointed, stained or covered with (instr. or comp.), ib.; MBh.; R. &c.
प्र-˚दिग्ध n. (scil. मांस) a kind of dish prepared with meat, L.
प्र-˚दिग्ध m. a kind of sauce or gravy, W.
प्र-दि॑व् f. (fr. 3. दिव्, ‘heaven’; nom. -द्यौ॑स्) the third or highest heaven (in which the Pitṛs are said to dwell), AV.
the fifth of seven heavens, ŚāṅkhBr.
प्र-दि॑व् mfn. (fr. 3. दिव्, ‘day’ [cf. Lat. diu]) existing from olden times, ancient, RV.
प्र-दि॑वस् ind. from of old, long since, always, ever (अ॑नुप्रद्˚, as of old, as formerly), ib.; AV.
प्र-दि॑वि ind. at all times, always, ever, RV.
प्र-दि॑श् f. pointing to or out, indication, direction, order, command, dominion, RV.; AV.; VS.
a direction, quarter, region of the sky, ib.; MBh.; Hariv. (acc. pl. ‘in all directions, everywhere’, MBh.; with पित्र्या, ‘the region of the Pitṛs’ i.e. the south, AV.)
an intermediate point or half-quarter (as northeast), AV.; &c.
प्र॑-˚दिष्ट (प्र॑-), mfn. pointed out, indicated, fixed, ordained, RV.; &c.
प्र-देश m. (ifc. f(आ). ) pointing out, showing, indication, direction, decision, determination, Nir.; ŚrS.
appeal to a precedent, Suśr.
an example (in grammar, law &c.), RPrāt.; MBh.; Yājñ., Sch.
a spot, region, place, country, district (often in comp. with a part of the body, e.g. कण्ठ-, हृदय-), MBh.; Kāv. &c. (n., Pañcad.)
a short while (see comp. below)
a wall, L.
a short span (measured from the tip of the thumb to that of the forefinger), L.
(with Jainas) one of the obstacles to liberation, Sarvad. (‘atomic individuality’, W.)
प्र-देश &c. See प्र-√ दिश्.
प्रा—देश॑ m. (ifc. f(आ). ) the span of the thumb and forefinger (also a measure = 12 Aṅgulas), ŚBr.; GṛŚrS. : MBh. &c.
place, country, L. (v.l. for प्र-द्˚)
प्र-देश—कारिन् m. N. of a kind of ascetic, L.
प्र-देश—भाज् mfn. of short duration, Daśar.
प्र-देश—वत् mfn. possessing or occupying a place, Brahmas., Sch.
प्र-देश—वर्तिन् mfn. = -भाज् (˚ति-ता f.), Hcar.
प्र-देश—वर्ति-त्वा f.
प्र-देश—शास्त्र n. a book containing examples, MBh.
प्र-देश—स्थ mfn. = -भाज्, Sāh.
being or situated in a district, MW.
प्र-˚देशन n. a gift, present, offering, L.
प्रा—देशन n. = प्र-देशन, a gift &c., L.
प्र-˚देशनी f. = ˚शिनी, L.
प्र-˚देशित mfn. urged, directed, MBh.
प्र-˚देशिनी f. the forefinger (or the corresponding toe), ŚrS.; MBh. &c.
प्रा—देशिनी f. the forefinger, KātyŚr., Sch. (prob. w.r. for प्र-देशिनी)
प्र-˚देष्टृ m. one who pronounces judgement, chief justice, Pañcat.
प्र-√ दिह् P. -देग्धि, to smear over, besmear, anoint, Suśr.
प्र-˚देह m. a plaster, a thick or viscid ointment, poultice, Suśr.
applying a plaster, unction, ib.
solid food (perhaps inspissated juice &c.), ib.
प्र-˚देहन n. smearing, anointing, Kauś.

प्र-√ दीप् Ā. -दीप्यते, to flame forth, blaze, burst into flames, ŚBr.; MBh.; Var. :
Caus. -दीपयति, to set on fire, light, kindle, inflame, KātyŚr.; MBh. &c.

प्र-˚दीप m. a light, lamp, lantern, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (often ifc. ‘the light i.e. the glory or ornament of’ e.g. कुल-प्र्˚, q.v.; also in titles of explanatory works = elucidation, explanation, e.g. महाभाष्य-प्र्˚)
N. of wk.
प्र-˚दीप—मञ्जरी f. N. of Comm. on the Amara-koṣa
प्र-˚दीप—शरण-ध्वज m. N. of a Mahoraga-rāja, L.
प्र-˚दीप—साह m. N. of a prince, Cat. (साह = شاه)
प्र-˚दीप—सिंह m. N. of an author, Cat.
प्र-˚दीपक mf(इका)n. a small lamp, a lamp, MBh.
(ifc.) explanation, commentary, Cat.
प्र-˚दीपन mfn. inflaming, exciting, Suśr.
प्र-˚दीपन m. a sort of poison, L.
प्र-˚दीपन n. the act of kindling or inflaming, R.
प्र-˚दीपाय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to act as a lamp, Mṛcch.
प्र-˚दीपीय or प्र-˚दीप्य, mfn. g. अपूपादि.
प्र-˚दीपीय or प्र-˚दीप्य, mfn. g. अपूपादि.
प्र-˚दीप्त mfn. kindled, inflamed, burning, shining, ŚBr. &c. &c.
excited, stimulated, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
(in augury) clear, shrill (opp. to पूर्ण), VarBṛS.
प्र-˚दीप्त—भास् mfn. shining bright, Ṛt.
प्र-˚दीप्त—शिरस् mfn. one whose head is hot or burning, Vedāntas.
प्र-˚दीप्˚ताक्ष m. ‘having lustrous eyes’, N. of a Yakṣa, Kathās.
प्र-˚दीप्ति f. light, lustre, brilliancy, L.
प्र-˚दीप्ति—मत् mfn. bright, radiant, luminous, MBh.
प्र-दीर्घ mfn. exceedingly long, Var.; Suśr.

प्र-√ 2. दु Ā. -दूयते, to be consumed by fire, ChUp.;
 P. -दुनोति, to distress, pain, press hard, Suśr.; Bhaṭṭ.
प्र-˚दव्य᳙ m. (with अग्नि) a forest fire, ŚBr.
प्र-˚दाव्य᳙ m. (with अग्नि) id., TS.; ŚāṅkhBr.; ŚrS.
प्र-दुग्ध See अ॑- and सव्य-प्रदुग्ध.
प्रादुष् in comp. for प्रादुर् (cf. above).
प्र-˚दुष्ट mfn. corrupt, wicked, bad, sinful, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
wanton, licentious (woman), Ṛt.
प्र-˚दूषक mfn. polluting, defiling, MBh.
प्र-˚दूषण mfn. corrupting, defiling, impairing, MBh.; Suśr.
प्र-˚दूषित mfn. corrupted, spoilt, made worse, MBh.; R.; Var.; Suśr.
1. प्र-˚दोष mfn. (for 2. See col. 2) corrupt, bad, wicked, Śiś.
प्र-˚दोष m. defect, fault, disordered condition (of the body or of a country), mutiny, rebellion, Pañcat.
2. प्र-दोष m. (for 1. See under प्र-दुष्) the first part of the night, evening (also personified as a son of Doṣā and associated with Niśitha and Vyuṣṭa), MBh.; Kāv.; Pur. &c.
प्रा—दोष mfn. belonging or relating to the evening, vespertine, Bhpr.
प्र-˚दोष—निर्णय m. N. of wk.
प्र-˚दोष—शान्ति f. N. of wk.
प्र-˚दो˚षोद्यापन n. N. of wk.
प्र-दुह् mfn. (nom. -धुक्) milking, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 61, Sch.
प्र-˚दोह See सु-प्रदोह.
प्र-˚दोहन m. N. of a man (see प्रादोहनि).

प्र-√ दृश् Pass. -दृश्यते (cf. प्र√ पश्), to become visible, be seen, appear, RV. &c. &c.:
Caus. -दर्शयति, to make visible, show, indicate, explain, teach, describe, Mn.; MBh. &c.:
Desid. -दिदृक्षते, to wish to see, Bhaṭṭ.
प्र-˚दर्शक mfn. showing, indicating, RPrāt.
proclaiming, foretelling, MārkP.
teaching, expounding, Cat.
प्र-˚दर्शक m. a teacher, MBh.
प्र-˚दर्शक n. (?) a doctrine, principle, Kap., Sch. (v.l. प्र-घट्टक).
प्र-˚दर्शन n. look, appearance (often ifc., with f(आ). ), MBh.; R.
pointing out, showing, propounding, teaching, explaining, RPrāt.; MBh.; Śaṃk.
an example, Yājñ.
prophesying, W.
प्र-˚दर्शन m. pl. N. of a class of deities under Manu Auttami, VP.
प्र-˚दर्शना f. indication, Kāvyād., Sch.
प्र-˚दर्शित mfn. shown, pointed out, indicated
taught, mentioned, specified, Mn.; MBh. &c.
prophesied, W.
प्र-˚दर्शिन् mfn. (ifc.) seeing, viewing, MBh.; Suśr.
pointing out, showing, indicating, MBh.; Hariv.; Kathās.

प्र-√ दॄ (of P. only Ved. Impv. -द॑र्षि), to break or tear to pieces, RV. vi, 26, 5 :
Pass. -दीर्यते, to cleave asunder, split open (intr.), AitBr.; KātyŚr.;
to be dispersed or scattered (as an army), MBh. :
Caus. -दारयति, to split, cleave, tear asunder, ib.
प्र-दोष॑म् (अ॑म्), ind. in the evening, in the dark, RV.; GṛŚrS.
प्र-दोष—काल m. evening tide, Hit.
प्र-दोष—तिमिर n. ev˚ darkness, the dusk of early night, Mṛcch.
प्र-दोष—पूजा-विधि m. N. of wk.
प्र-दोष—महिमन् m. N. of wk.
प्र-दोष—माहात्म्य n. N. of wk.
प्र-दोष—रमणीय mfn. pleasant or delightful in the ev˚, MW.
प्र-दोष—वेला f. = -काल, A.
प्र-दोष—शिव-पूजा f. N. of wk.
प्र-दोष—समय m. = -काल, A.
प्र-दोष—स्तोत्र n. N. of ch. of SkandaP.
प्रदोषागम m. the coming on of ev˚, nightfall, Amar.
प्रदोषानिल m. the evening wind, Mṛcch.
प्रदोषक m. evening, Mṛcch. v, 35 (v.l.)
born in the evening (?), Pāṇ. iv, 3, 28.
प्र-द्यु n. merit (of good works) leading to heaven or securing heaven, L.

प्र-√ 1. द्युत् Ā. -द्योतते, to begin to shine, ŚBr. :
Caus. -द्योतयति, to irradiate, illumine, Prab.; BhP.
प्र-˚द्युतित mfn. beginning to shine, illuminated, Pāṇ. i, 2, 21, Sch.
प्र-द्योत॑ m. radiance, light, ŚBr.
a ray of l˚, L.
N. of a Yakṣa, MBh.
of a king of Magadha and founder of a dynasty, VP.; Kathās.
of a king of Ujjayinī and other princes, Lalit.; Priyad.; BhP.
प्र-˚द्योतन m. the sun, L.
N. of a prince of Ujjayinī, Lalit.
प्र-˚द्योतन m. (with भट्टाचार्य) N. of an author, Cat.
(pl.) of a dynasty, BhP.
प्र-˚द्योतन n. blazing, shining, light, L.
प्र-˚द्योतित mfn. = ˚द्युतित, Pāṇ. i, 2, 21, Sch.
प्र-˚द्योतिन् mfn. (ifc.) illustrating, explaining, Cat.
प्र-द्युम्न m. ‘the pre-eminently mighty one’, N. of the god of love (re-born as a son of Kṛṣṇa and Rukmiṇī, or as a son of Saṃkarṣaṇa and then identified with Sanat-kumāra), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
the pleasant (= काम), Subh.
the intellect (= मनस्), Śaṃk.
N. of a son of Manu and Naḍvalā, BhP.
of a king, Kathās.
of sev. authors and teachers, Cat.
of a mountain, Rājat.
of a river, ib.
प्र-द्युम्न—पुर n. ‘Pradyumna's city’, N. of a town on the Candra-bhāgā or Chenab, Kathārṇ.
प्र-द्युम्न—रहस्य n. ‘P˚'s secret’, N. of wk.

प्रा—दु॑र् See s.v.

प्रादु॑र् ind. (prob. fr. प्रा = प्र + दुर्, ‘out of doors’; प्रा-दु॑स्, g. स्वर्-आदि; ˚दुष् before क् and प्, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 41; ˚दुः ष्यात्, षन्ति for स्यात्, सन्ति, 87) forth, to view or light, in sight, AV. &c. &c. (with √ अस्, or भू, to become manifest, be visible or audible, appear, arise, exist; with √ कृ, to make visible or manifest, cause to appear, reveal, disclose).

प्रा—देश—सम mf(आ)n. id., KātyŚr.
प्रा—दे˚शायाम mf(आ)n. id., Gobh.

प्रा—देशिन् mfn. a span long, Gṛhyās.
प्रा—दो˚षिक mfn. id., Pañcat. (cf. Pāṇ. iv, 3, 14).
